title: Choosing Kind Words During Disagreement
paragraphs: Ridwan and his roommate are talking about house chores. The talk becomes tense. Ridwan wants to mention an old problem so that he can win the argument.
Before he speaks, Ridwan stops. He knows that the old problem is not about the chores. It may hurt his roommate and make the small problem much bigger.
Ridwan stays with the real topic. He explains his view calmly. He does not use insults or make the problem sound worse than it is.
At the end, they make a fair plan for the chores. Ridwan feels glad that he chose kind words instead of a small win that could hurt their friendship.
